atoms.name: Grammars and derivations
atoms.one_line: A step rewrites one nonterminal; the language is every terminal string the start symbol reaches.

atoms.name: Parse trees and ambiguity
atoms.one_line: Ambiguous means one string has two parse trees, equivalently two leftmost derivations.

atoms.name: Language of a grammar
atoms.one_line: Say what each rule adds, then name the language: matched pairs, counters, palindromes.

atoms.name: Designing a grammar
atoms.one_line: Matched core plus an extra, union of cases, wrap-and-base for palindromes.

atoms.name: PDA moves and acceptance
atoms.one_line: Read, pop the top, push a string; accept by final state or empty stack.

atoms.name: DPDA versus NPDA
atoms.one_line: DCFL is strictly inside CFL; a missing marker for the middle forces a guess.

atoms.name: CFL closure
atoms.one_line: Closed under union, concatenation, star, reversal and intersection with regular; not under intersection or complement.

atoms.name: CNF and GNF
atoms.one_line: CNF: A→BC or A→a, derivation 2n−1 steps. GNF: A→aα, derivation n steps.

atoms.name: CYK
atoms.one_line: Triangle table of n(n+1)/2 cells, O(n^3) split checks, start symbol in the top cell means membership.

atoms.name: Count invariants
atoms.one_line: Per-rule additions to the counts of a and b give relations that hold for every string.

patterns.name: Identify the language of a grammar
Count relations that hold for every string
